about: Evaluation assets (measurement.md rule 29, T11): each is versioned, hashed and listed here with its size, who labelled it and the criteria that use it. An item is never edited to improve a result; a change is a new version, and the earlier hash is kept. Labels are a person's or executed, never a model's. Nothing is scored against an asset that is not listed. B2.4's reference solutions are labelled by execution (each passed its card's frozen tests; scripts/verify_reference_solutions.mjs records and registers them); its golden briefs and held-out acceptance suite wait for a person's labels and are not registered yet. B4.4's research golden set (25 questions, fixtures/research_golden/drafts) is drafted by an agent and waits for a person to check and label every answer; it is not registered yet, so the Researcher bake-off and the Researcher's screen do not run. B4.8's reviewer seeded defects are labelled by execution (scripts/verify_seeded_defects.mjs: each defect passes its issue's frozen tests, typecheck and lint and fails a witness test that passes on the reference solution); its PM conversations (fixtures/pm_conversations/drafts) wait for a person's labels and are not registered.

assets.name: reference-solutions
assets.labelledBy: frozen tests (each solution executed against its card's frozen acceptance test)
assets.provenance: written by an agent (claude-opus-5-5), verified by the frozen tests

assets.name: reviewer-seeded-defects
assets.labelledBy: frozen tests (each defect passes its card's frozen tests, typecheck and lint, and fails a witness test that passes on the reference solution)
assets.provenance: seeded by an agent (claude-opus-5-5) into the verified reference solutions; each defect executed against its card's frozen tests and its witness test
